sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Nemain, also named Neman or Neamhan, is an Irish goddess. She is one of the three war goddesses called the Morrigan. Of the trio she is the least known. The better-known members are Badb, the scald crow, and the Morrighan, also named the great queen or the queen of phantoms. The name Nemain seems to carry the sense of battle panic or the frenzy of war. So violent was the madness she sent that warriors sometimes mistook their own friends for enemies.
